sentences.text:
Anindya Kusum @ Anindya Kumar Saha & Anr vs The State Of
West Bengal & Anr on 2 December, 2025
02.12.2025
Ct. No.42
D/L 19
Mujahid
 Crr 3692 of 2025
 Anindya Kusum @ Anindya Kumar Saha & Anr.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Jayanta Narayan Chatterjee, Sr. Adv.
 Ms. P. Mukhopadyay
 Ms. R. Banerjee
 ...for the petitioners

1. 
Present petition has been filed for quashing of Sc 299/2024 (Gr case no.1143/2022) arising out of
Electronics Complex P.S. Case No.189 of 2022 dated 19th November, 2022 under Sections
417/323/354/376/506/511/307/34 of the Ipc.
2.
Learned senior counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioner no.1 and opposite party no.2 came into contact through a matrimonial site and started meeting each other.
Learned counsel submits that both are major and having consensual relationship with each other which did not fructify ultimately.
Learned counsel submits that opposite party no.2 had also taken money various time from the petitioner no.1 as being reflected from the bank statement filed along with the present petition.
Learned counsel submits that it is false and frivolous case and has been filed only to harass the petitioners.

Petitioner no.2 is stated to be the mother of the petitioner no.1.
3. Issue notice to the State of West Bengal through office of the learned Public Prosecutor.
Opposite party no.2 be also served.
5. Let the matter be listed in the combined monthly list of February, 2026.
